description: Extracts connection failure and CPU usage from _raw log lines

script.source: if (ctx.containsKey('_raw')) { String msg = ctx._raw.toLowerCase(); if (msg.contains('connection') && (msg.contains('fail') || msg.contains('timeout') || msg.contains('refused') || msg.contains('broken pipe'))) { ctx.conn_fail = 1; } java.util.regex.Matcher m = /cpu=(\d+)/.matcher(ctx._raw); if (m.find()) { ctx.cpu = Integer.parseInt(m.group(1)); } }
